name: composer-select
title: Composer Select
description: A choice of one from a composer's toolbar, such as a mode or an agent: a trigger that says the choice, and its items (a label, a line of description, a detail, a tick on the chosen one) over the composer, a search over more than searchFrom of them (10; 0 for always) that filters them by their words and keywords, in their order, its match in the text's colour, the chosen one still chosen while filtered out, a pinned item never filtered out nor marked, the search's text the app's with search and onSearchChange, and says when nothing matches, or in a sheet from the bottom with a title and Done on a phone (below sm, 640px: useComposerPhone). Arrow keys move among the items, Enter, Space or a click chooses and closes. ComposerModePicker: the app's modes; one with tone "destructive" (it lets the agent act unasked) is, chosen, in the destructive colour in the toolbar, its icon too, and its icon so in the list; a footer under the modes is a line of small grey text with a link or button in it (ComposerSelectContent's footer, past a hairline, in sight while the list scrolls). Its row look (composerSelectRow) and parts are what model-picker is built on. ComposerOptionButton: a button in the trigger's look, out of a ComposerSelect, for an option of the composer's row that opens something else (a dialog) or acts at once, a chevron after its words with `chevron`.
